title: LevelHead: Deskew Before You Classify
desc: A training-free method for page deskewing and orientation classification. LevelHead levels the page with a spectral deskewer first, then lets any frozen classifier or VLM vote over the four quarter turns of the level page. On pages at any angle it lifts four Qwen3-VL models from 41.9% to 84.6% and four orientation classifiers from 71.9% to 85.2%.

title: Post-Audit Mirage: Identifiability Limits of Offline Agent Verification
venue: Accepted · Who Verifies the Agents? Workshop at NeurIPS 2026 (Poster)

gallery.label: The mirage
gallery.alt: A safe world and a harmful world give an offline verifier the same evidence and the same result, but deployment reveals delayed harm in only one of them
gallery.caption: Same offline evidence, different real truth.

gallery.label: Monitor
gallery.alt: Fresh group-labelled outcomes pass through a group-aware monitor that can deploy, hold, request more evidence, or report unsupported
gallery.caption: A fail-closed monitor that acts only on fresh post-update evidence.

desc: A matched-world benchmark for offline agent verification. A safe and a harmful deployment can leave byte-identical audit records while needing opposite decisions, so no offline verifier can tell them apart. Across authorization, scheduling, and shared-capacity environments, the paper shows when fresh post-update evidence restores the decision, and gives a fail-closed monitor that deploys, holds, asks for more evidence, or reports unsupported.

title: Mixing Matters? Position Bias Across Sequence Mixers
venue: Accepted · PriGM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026, Paris
image_alt: Accuracy by evidence position for Pythia 2.8B, Mamba 2.8B, and Mamba-2 2.7B
desc: A paired study of position bias across Transformer, Mamba, and hybrid language models. One answer-bearing passage moves through ten positions of a fixed long context while everything else stays the same. Pythia favours the opening and the Mamba checkpoints do not; the paper reports this as a model-family difference, not an isolated architecture effect.

title: RDAN-GRPO
desc: Rubric Decoupled Advantage Normalisation GRPO is a rubric-based reinforcement learning repository for aligning LLMs with complex, open-domain instruction-following tasks. It improves performance on public instruction-following benchmarks.

title: MycoGate-VL
image_alt: MycoGate-VL example: the claimed count of eight lights is annotated as a hallucinated span with miscounting and invention labels
desc: Detects and categorizes hallucinated character spans in vision-language responses across English, French, Italian, and Chinese. Combines multilingual detectors, a learned clean-document gate, visual category supervision, and scorer-aware output serialization.
